questions.stem: A pipeline must start whenever a new file lands in a storage folder. What do you set up?

options.text: A storage event trigger for the pipeline

questions.explanation: Event-based triggers start a pipeline when events such as a file being created occur, so it runs as soon as the file arrives instead of polling.

questions.stem: The event trigger from the previous design must fire only for .csv files in one folder. What do you configure?

options.text: An event filter on the Subject field that matches the folder name and the .csv file type
A ForEach activity that ignores other files
A second pipeline to delete other files

questions.explanation: Event triggers can filter events by folder name, file name, file type and container through the Subject field, so only matching files start the pipeline.

questions.stem: Where do you set a pipeline to run every day at 02:00?
questions.explanation: Each pipeline has a schedule with a frequency, start time and time zone.

questions.stem: Which three can start a pipeline run? Each correct answer is a complete solution.

options.text: Opening the lakehouse it writes to
An event trigger, such as a file arriving in storage

questions.explanation: A pipeline runs on demand, on a schedule, or when an event trigger fires. Labels and opening items don't start runs.
